label: rejected

evidence.V1: Instantly reads as a four-post bed from front, three-quarter, top and silhouette (arched headboard, corner posts with ball finials, footboard).
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big = frame and mattress, medium = headboard arch, footboard, blanket and pillow, small = gold ball finials and the folded blanket band.
evidence.V3: Mattress is a plain flat box, blanket is a thin slab and the pillow is a hard trapezoid wedge; no puffiness or sag on the soft goods, so it reads as stiff primitives despite the nice arched headboard.
evidence.V4: Bevel widths are inconsistent: the pillow has a large 45-degree chamfer while posts, rails and mattress edges have tiny chamfers that barely catch light.
evidence.V5: Blanket-fold close-up shows the folded band's end as a separate block stepping out past the blanket's side face, reading as an intersection rather than a fold; finials slightly faceted.
evidence.V6: One fabric hue (blanket, 2 values), frame wood in 2 browns, cream bedding, gold finials: disciplined within the furniture spec.
evidence.V7: 888 tris vs medium target 2000 / ceiling 4000: well under target.
evidence.V8: Single LF_VertexColor material, gold fittings, cream bedding, wood frame; royal and verdant colourways swap only the blanket hue as intended.
evidence.V9: Anchored, CollisionFidelity Box, CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre: correct.

artifacts: folded blanket band end protrudes as a separate stepped block beyond the blanket side
top_fixes: Make the soft goods soft: rounded, slightly puffy mattress edges, a plump pillow with pinched corners, and a blanket that drapes over the mattress sides
Rebuild the blanket fold so the turned-back band wraps the blanket edge cleanly instead of a block poking out the side
Unify bevel width across frame, pillow and mattress (~0.05-0.07 studs on the frame, softer rounding on fabric)
